name: Voxel / blocky 3D diorama
look: a world of cubes (Minecraft, Monument Valley with blocks), voxel models rotating, building up cube by cube.

fits.notes: infra, building/"compose" products, cloud, creative tools; family/playful

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: blocky display or mono; flat saturated colours, one hue per material, cheap ambient occlusion.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is one material hue and the hero block; other materials stay neutral
brand_lock.type_role: blocky display or mono for labels, brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: cube world built by staggered instance growth
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: instanced cubes growing via staggered scale
orthographic camera rotating 90 degrees per beat
"bake in" from random blocks to the object
cubes dissolving into the next object
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: voxel isometric scene of {subject}, flat saturated colours, one hue per material, plain background (palette reference board only; geometry is modelled in code)
codex_assets.r1_note: concept boards only (voxel isometric scene); use as palette references, then model procedurally in code (Codex voxel images can't be loaded as geometry). Or a depth-guess heightmap to extrude into voxels.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.engine_meaning: gap (nothing yet) / reference only (builder hand-codes it)
build.recipe: Three.js `InstancedMesh` (stage3d ships `VOXLoader.js`), orthographic camera, `MeshStandardMaterial` + baked-looking AO via vertex colours, GSAP stagger on instance matrices (seek-safe: compute from `t`). Add a posterise pass.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is the hero block material (the product's block, the glowing core); terrain, sky and ink stay style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Mono labels float as billboards beside blocks; keep 1-2 words.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

passes.role: limits tonal steps so faces stay flat

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: isometric or 3/4 high camera on a cube grid; 1 unit = 1 block; vertical stacks of 3-7 blocks
composition.safe_area: 12% margin; hero structure on the right third, sky left for type
composition.fill: structure fills 55-65% of height; ground plane runs off the frame
composition.product_ui: UI shows on a flat screen block or a floating billboard plane aligned to the cube grid

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: orthographic three-quarter high angle, 35 degrees down, no perspective distortion, shallow tilt-shift. Lighting: one soft sun from upper left, flat ambient fill, ambient occlusion in block corners. Material: matte cubes with visible 1-voxel seams, slight bevel, no reflections. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: flat colour per block with a 3-tone shade per face; sparse colour noise. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no smooth organic curves, no sub-voxel detail, no mixed block sizes, no photoreal textures, no glossy reflections.
codex.camera: orthographic three-quarter high angle, 35 degrees down, no perspective distortion, shallow tilt-shift
codex.lighting: one soft sun from upper left, flat ambient fill, ambient occlusion in block corners
codex.material: matte cubes with visible 1-voxel seams, slight bevel, no reflections
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: flat colour per block with a 3-tone shade per face; sparse colour noise

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: matte cubes with visible 1-voxel seams; orthographic three-quarter high angle; sky-blue haze, deep navy ink, safety orange, butter yellow.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Fix one voxel size for the entire scene
Use 3 face-shades per colour for readable form
Leave one empty sky quadrant for the claim
dont: Do not mix voxel scale (tiny block next to big block)
cheap_ways: Minecraft grass-block clone with brand logo on the side
Random floating cubes with no structure
Soft blurry renders where seams disappear
